text:
devon: quick ping — can someone take a 5min look at my PR to onboard gpt-medium-v2 and a tokenizer tweak? https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pull/4832 :wave:
aria: on it, what are the main risks here?
devon: tl;dr: tokenizer change fixes newline+emoji splitting for our customer logs, adds an escaping rule. also adds a fallback tokenization profile for short-chat settings. no model weights changed.
sam: can you paste the tokenizer diff inline? quick scan first.
devon: sure — snippet from the PR:
```diff
- split_on_whitespace = True
+ split_on_whitespace = False
+ escape_control_chars = True
+ // new: treat combined emoji sequences as single token
```
linh: hmm, change to split_on_whitespace might affect legacy embeddings. did you run the eval suite?
devon: ran local evals against our embed-regression set — delta <0.2% on average but one outlier for short inputs. I added a conditional fallback profile for embeddings to keep previous behavior.
aria: where is the fallback wired? I can't find in the config YAML.
devon: it's under configs/model_profiles/gpt-medium-v2/fallback.yaml — lines 12-28. basically: if input_tokens < 8 -> use legacy-tokenizer profile.
ci-bot: build passed — unit tests: 312 passed, 4 skipped; integration: tokenizer-regression-suite passed.
sam: can you add an explicit assert in the tests for emoji sequences? that was the failure mode last time.
devon: good point — will add. also tagging @linh because this touches embedding path and we might want a quick smoke on dedicated staging.
linh: I'll run staging smoke tomorrow morning. if it looks good we can merge after a second approve.
aria: I can review the config YAML and rollout policy today. expect comments by EOD.
devon: thanks! timeline: if both approve by tomorrow morning I plan to merge after the staging smoke (target merge window 10:30am PT). please @mention me if you run into anything blocking. :pray:
sam: left one nit + suggestion for clearer comment. non-blocking.
devon: addressed both, pushed a small fix.
aria: left two small YAML nits, one around indentation and one about the rollout policy for canary percent.
devon: fixed both and bumped canary to 5% with 30m ramp. pushed.
linh: staging smoke complete — no regressions in ranking/embeddings on our quickset.
aria: LGTM from me for configs.
sam: approving now.
devon: awesome — will wait 30m then merge and kick deploy. thanks all! :rocket:
